result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered, but there are a few visual defects: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, truncated text on the third carousel card, and a partially clipped category chip. Overall functionality appears intact.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side with the same image, delivery time (15–25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90), which looks like a data duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant entries in the carousel data source so each restaurant appears only once.

issues.description: The third carousel card's title 'Smash Bros Bu…' is cut off at the right screen edge with no visible ellipsis handling, making the restaurant name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis within the card bounds, or ensure card peeking still leaves the title legible after horizontal scroll.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge, showing only a small sliver, which looks broken rather than like an intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/padding so the partially visible chip shows enough content (e.g., a letter or two) to clearly indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' cards use identical placeholder-looking food illustrations rather than real restaurant photos, which appears inconsistent with the photo-based cards elsewhere (e.g., Tokumaru Ramen Bar).
issues.suggestion: Use actual restaurant imagery or a consistent fallback image style so placeholder graphics don't stand out as broken content.
